تفترشي (form VIII)
# تَفْتَرِشِي (taftarišī) /taf.ta.ri.ʃiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَشَ (iftaraša)
# تُفْتَرَشِي (tuftarašī) /tuf.ta.ra.ʃiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَشَ (iftaraša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
